description: This Java class provides utility methods to check network connectivity status and type within an Android application. It allows retrieval of current network connection type (Wi-Fi, mobile, or none) and returns a descriptive string based on the connection status.

classes.name: NetworkUtil
classes.description: Utility class for checking network connectivity type and status within an Android app.

methods.name: getConnectivityStatus
methods.description: Returns an integer indicating the current network connectivity type: Wi-Fi, mobile data, or not connected.

methods.name: getConnectivityStatusString
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string describing the current network connectivity status.
